The '''Flux Screw fleet''' was a part of the [[Ebruchi (fleet)|Ebruchi]], the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Ebruchi|eponymous]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. It was [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by an Ebruchi [[Unidentified Ebruchi chieftain|chieftain]], who commanded the Ebruchi [[High captain]] [[Common Cork]]. Urgent reports from the Ebruchi [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ness (pirate)|Ness]], Cork's subordinate, could bring the weight of the chieftain's fleet on any parties who defied Ness's demands.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Flux Screw fleet was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
